chunks: But those who covet more than this will be transgressors;
ai.seo_question: Who are considered the transgressors (al-'adun) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mu'minun is frequently linked to the preceding verses on marriage and divorce, establishing a comprehensive legal framework where exceeding divine boundaries constitutes 'al-'adun' (transgressors). It underscores the principle that God's limits are not merely restrictions but safeguards of justice, a concept central to Usuli jurisprudence when deriving rulings from the Quran. The verse serves as a foundational warning against arbitrary expansion of permissions or contraction of obligations, emphasizing strict adherence to the 'hudud' (limits) set by the Divine.
